Guidance & outlook: I am pleased to share that we have started FY27 on a strong note, delivering record financial performance and crossing the INR8,000 crores quarterly EBITDA milestone for the first time.

As we progress on our 2 x growth journey and capitalize on the long-term structural demand outlook for zinc and silver, we remain confident in our ability to create sustainable value for all stakeholders.
So the guidance for the year is on the growth project is around USD500 million to USD600 million we are expecting.
Growth & demand: While near-term price movements may remain volatile, the medium -term outlook continues to be constructive, driven by structural demand from the energy transition and relatively constrained global supply growth.

Our ability to generate strong free cash flow of INR5,253 crores pre growth capex, demonstrate the resilience of our business model, industry -leading cost competitiveness and disciplined Hindustan Zinc Limited July 24, 2026 Public (C4) financial management.

We ended this quarter with a net cash position of INR5,572 crores, providing significant financial flexibility to pursue value -accretive growth opportunities while maintaining an attractive shareholder return profile.
Margins & costs: During the quarter, we reported highest ever EBITDA of INR8,074 crores, resulting into a record net profit of INR5,469 crores, making a new milestone for the company.

During the quarter, we delivered our highest ever quarterly revenue from operations of INR13,747 crores, up 77% year-on-year, driven by higher metal production, support ive commodity prices, better byproduct realization, lead concentrate sales and a stronger dollar.
We have also delivered the highest-ever quarterly EBITDA of INR8,074 crores, up 109% year- on-year, with an industry -leading EBITDA margin of 59%.
Capex & expansion: During his tenure, he spearheaded key initiatives in operational excellence, capacity expansion and digital transformation.
Manufacturing activity remained in expansion territory during the quarter, supported by resilient domestic demand, sustained government capital expenditure and continued infrastructure investments.
However, if you recall, when we commissioned the 1 million ton capacity, new mill in RD mine.
Balance sheet & cash: As demand for zinc, silver and critical minerals continue to be supported by global megatrends , we believe Hindustan Zinc is going to deliver sustainable growth, resilient cash flows and long -term value creation for our shareholders.
Our strong balance sheet, net cash position and disciplined capital allocation framework positions us well to fund future growth while continuing to reward shareholders.

Reflecting our confidence in the business and strong cash generation , during the quarter, the company paid its first interim dividend of INR11 per share, reaffirming our commitment to delivering sustainable shareholder returns.
